description: Fisher cites a reported lithium isotope dependence of the mothering behavior of rats chronically fed lithium-6 or lithium-7, and calls reproducing that experiment paramount.
limitations: A single older study, cited not repeated, and its reproduction is named by Fisher as the first need.

sources.quote: Remarkably, a lithium isotope dependence on the mothering behavior of rats chronically fed either 6 Li or 7 Li
